dialogues.text: About the train and the passing scenery

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Every time we're on the train, Paimon loves watching the mountains and ice fields whiz past the window!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right... There's something Paimon's been wanting to do for ages. First, we need to huff a little air onto the glass...
